column1: # TSX definitions: everything TypeScript has (fixtures/langs/typescript), and these component forms.
#  - a function component (declaration, arrow, or built by forwardRef, memo, lazy, styled) is a function; a class component is a class with its render method;
#  - `createContext(...)` and `export const X = 5` are constants; a constant that is not exported is not a definition;
#  - a JSX element is a use of a component and defines nothing.
